notes.title: Join the Beta Test for Our New Voice Chat Feature!
notes.content:
🦈 Hello Sharks! Join the Beta Test for Our New Voice Chat Feature! 🦈

We’re thrilled to announce an exclusive chance to dive into the beta test for our Voice Chat feature! This update will make gameplay more immersive and social, adding a new layer to your interactions. 3. Enter the code OBTVOICECHAT and click Check code.
4. Enter the BusinessTour game and have fun with Voice Chat!

Business Tour Championship Predict & Win Event

Event Overview:
Welcome to the Business Tour Championship Predict & Win Event! Get ready to immerse yourself in the thrilling world of strategic gameplay and prediction. As the top players battle it out in the online board game resembling Business Tour, you have the chance to participate and win exciting prizes by predicting the outcome of each match.

How to Participate:

Tune in to our live broadcast of Business Tour matches.
As a viewer, you have the opportunity to predict the winner of the ongoing match and their victory style.
Post your prediction in the comments section, along with your game ID.
Remember, only the first prediction from each participant will be counted, so make it count!
Prediction Options:

Line Monopoly Win: The player who buys all cities in one line secures victory.
Resort Win: Acquiring four resorts ensures a victory.
Triple Monopoly Win: Owning three cities of the same color results in a triumph.
Capital Win: If the game time runs out, the player with the most capital emerges victorious.
Perfect Win: Bankrupting all other players within the time limit guarantees an ultimate victory.
Prizes:

Correctly predict the color of the winner: 100 gold prize.ːsteamhappyː
Correctly predict the exact outcome of the match: 500 gold prize.ːsteamhappyː

Rules and Guidelines:
Participants must include their game ID along with their prediction.
Avoid spamming comments; only the first prediction from each participant will be considered.
Be precise with your prediction to stand a chance to win.
Join the Excitement:
Don't miss out on the opportunity to be a part of the action-packed Business Tour Championship Predict & Win Event! Tune in, predict, and win big as you witness strategic gameplay unfold before your eyes. Get ready for an unforgettable gaming experience!
